title.en: An Act Making It the Duty of the National Museum to Cooperate in the Preservation of Permanent Public Works and Monuments of Value to Philippine History and Culture, and Authorizing the Director of the National Museum to Make Rules and Regulations for Carrying Out the Purposes of this Act.
title.orig: An Act Making It the Duty of the National Museum to Cooperate in the Preservation of Permanent Public Works and Monuments of Value to Philippine History and Culture, and Authorizing the Director of the National Museum to Make Rules and Regulations for Carrying Out the Purposes of this Act.

text.en:
The Director of the National Museum, subject to the approval of the Secretary of Agriculture
and Natural Resources, may make rules and regulations for carrying out the provisions of this Act.

All acts and parts of acts inconsistent with the Repealing clause, provisions of this Act are
hereby repealed.

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, November 21, 1930.
